summary: Prepare the first real production-code SDK write lane for explicit approval review. This artifact does not enable production-code SDK writes.
requiredApprovalRecord: A later milestone must record an explicit approval decision in plans/target-app-execplan.md before SDK_WRITE_ALLOWED_SCOPES or production-code sdk-write acceptance can change.
preEnablementChecks: Run node --check scripts/provider-contract-smoke.js before any future write-lane approval.
Run node --check orchestrator/run-write-capable-scaffold.mjs and node --check orchestrator/run-buffered-acceptance.mjs after the approval change.
Run npm.cmd run codex:orchestrator:write-scaffold:contract to prove the new lane behavior remains contract-gated.
Run npm.cmd run check:rules to validate review packets, readiness packets, and SDK scope gates.
Run the configured local smoke suite before creating any SDKThread for this production-code lane.
approvalEvidenceRequired: Review this readiness artifact alongside the source M129 scope expansion packet.
Confirm the lane remains limited to scripts/provider-contract-smoke.js.
Confirm production-code remains absent from SDK_WRITE_ALLOWED_SCOPES until the later approval milestone.
Record validation and rollback evidence before creating any SDKThread for this lane.
rollbackPlan: If explicit approval is not recorded, keep SDK_WRITE_ALLOWED_SCOPES unchanged and leave production-code rejected by the sdk-write operation envelope gate; remove this readiness artifact or supersede it in a later milestone if the lane scope changes.
